rules.statement: When a CI workflow's inline script decides whether a security-sensitive action runs (such as enabling auto-merge with write permissions), have a test run that decision logic against fixture inputs, not just check that strings appear in the YAML.
rules.why: Checking only for strings lets a bug in the classifier ship with the suite still passing. It could then either auto-merge a pull request that changes more than intended or block every legitimate case.
rules.check: Look for new or changed `run:` logic in workflow files that gates merges, deployments or permission use. Confirm a test runs that logic, for example by extracting the step body or moving it into a testable script and running it against a stub `gh` and fixtures. The fixtures should cover the accepted case and each refused case: extra edits, out-of-scope paths, added, removed or renamed files, empty input and no input.

rules.statement: When you rewrap a paragraph in a comment or help block, wrap it to the same width as the paragraphs around it.
rules.why: A line that runs past the block's width makes the comment block wrap unevenly with the paragraphs around it.
rules.check: In rewrapped comment or help text, look for a line that runs well past the column width of the lines around it (for example, about 120 columns).
